value.title: Prime is pij-kind-parrotfish from 22 Nov (was far-jackal)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
On 22 Nov at 15:16, Jordan ruled (spine 4730261) that pij-kind-parrotfish is the pij-fleet prime, replacing pij-far-jackal. Send escalations, decisions and wakes to parrotfish. Never compact the prime: that now means parrotfish. far-jackal is no longer the prime; treat it as any other seat and ask parrotfish before acting on it.
Also from 22 Nov: ruling C35 means no new feature work without Jordan, and PA never revives or restarts non-pij-fleet seats (Jordan revives those himself).
